name: Organization chart
summary: A single-root team structure, with reporting lines and child depths.
description: Show one organization or reporting tree with 1 to 8 short entries. Use one list: the first entry is the level-zero root and each child sets its zero-based level. Keep parents before their children, without skipping a depth. Mark an assistant with "assistant": true among its manager's reports; separate roots need a diagram instead, and unsupported trees retain the complete list with a finding.
